name: Contraxx Furniture
old_description: “Impressive to see the level of craftsmanship and attention to detail in this furniture. Contraxx is a business founded on small town values that delivers world class quality to some of the most discerning clients in America.” – David W.
about:
Contraxx Furniture is based in McConnelsville, Ohio. The company traces its roots to the 1990s when it developed a hub-and-spoke manufacturing system to keep furniture production in the United States. The business grew from a small-town operation into a nationally recognized custom hospitality furniture manufacturer.

Contraxx manufactures custom hospitality furniture including guest room casegoods, beds, seating, banquettes, tables, lobby cabinetry, and bespoke furnishings for hotels, resorts, restaurants, casinos, senior living, and mixed-use properties. Its hub-and-spoke network connects more than 45 family-owned craft shops specializing in woodworking, metal fabrication, upholstery, and finishing, with final assembly and finishing performed in two state-of-the-art factories. The company reports having created over 5,000 skilled jobs in America and operates with no minimum order requirements, backed by a 15-point quality assurance inspection on every product.

The firm serves designers, architects, purchasers, FF&E professionals, and developers across the hospitality sector. Concrete project examples include The Pearl in Nantucket, MA; Elliott House Boutique Hotel in Charleston, SC; Sheraton Grand in Los Angeles, CA; Grand Casinos; Four Seasons; Homewood Suites; and numerous upscale restaurants and bars such as Hank's Seafood, 1587 Prime Steakhouse, and St. Cecilia Restaurant.

Contraxx emphasizes its distributed manufacturing system as a differentiator, enabling efficient production, dependable timelines, and seamless execution at any scale. The company was founded on the belief that furniture manufacturing jobs should stay in America, and it highlights made-exclusively-in-America production, custom design flexibility, turnkey installation, on-site field measurements, and time-critical delivery as core value propositions.
